title: Cabman’s shelter
html_source: Numerous critics have pointed out that the cabman’s shelter corresponds nicely with Eumaeus' hut in Homer’s Odyssey. In the Odyssey, the Father (Odysseus) finally returns to Ithaca and is reunited with his son (Telemachus) at Eumaeus' hut.
